name: Seyaq for WooCommerce
author: Seyaq.ai

sections.description:
Seyaq (https://seyaq.ai) checks whether your store is recommended for real shopping questions, keeps your product data ready for compatible AI tools, and adds it to your own storefront.

What you get

  • Your AI visibility, measured — daily checks and a weekly report show where your store is recommended, answered by an AI assistant with live web search, next to the competitors you choose.
  • What to fix — clear recommendations, and a setup checklist that shows what is working on your storefront.
  • Product data AI tools can read — your catalog stays in sync, and each product page gets schema.org data in Arabic and English.
  • Your store’s AI agent page — compatible AI agents search your products through your store’s MCP server and send shoppers to your own checkout.
  • Everything in WordPress — plan, sync, checks and score on the Seyaq screen and the Dashboard widget, in Arabic or English.

How it works

  1. Install and activate the plugin.
  2. Click Connect to Seyaq, then sign in or create your account.
  3. Approve Seyaq in WooCommerce. Your store’s status appears in WordPress.

A Seyaq subscription is required, and a free trial is available. See plans and prices.

On your storefront, the plugin adds links to your store’s AI agent page and llms.txt file to every page, loads Seyaq’s product data on product pages, and points /llms.txt on your domain to your store’s file on Seyaq. You can switch both features on or off on the Seyaq screen.

External services

This plugin works with Seyaq (https://seyaq.ai), a service operated by Seyaq LLC. A Seyaq subscription is required. Nothing is sent to Seyaq before you click Connect to Seyaq.

  • Connect. When you click “Connect to Seyaq”, your browser opens Seyaq’s connect page (seyaq.ai) with this site’s address, the address of the Seyaq screen in your WordPress admin, the site title, your admin language, the plugin version and a one-time security value. You sign in or create your account there and approve WooCommerce access. Seyaq then sends you back with a one-time code, which this site exchanges with Seyaq’s API (api.seyaq.ai) for an access token for this site; the exchange also sends the site’s address, your admin language and the plugin version.
  • Store status. While connected, this site reads your store’s status from api.seyaq.ai — when you open the Seyaq screen or the WordPress Dashboard (at most every five minutes) and once a day — and sends Verify now and Disconnect requests there. These requests carry the access token only.
  • Store code. If you connect with a store code (under “Other ways to connect”), this site sends that code to api.seyaq.ai to find your store.
  • Storefront. Once connected, storefront pages load Seyaq’s loader script from Seyaq’s servers. The visitor’s browser sends the address of the page being viewed (including any query string, such as a search term) so Seyaq can return the matching product data; like any web request, this also reaches Seyaq with the visitor’s IP address. The loader does not run on cart, checkout or account pages; no names, emails or order details are sent. Requests for /llms.txt are redirected to your store’s llms.txt file on Seyaq.
  • Uninstall. Deleting the plugin tells api.seyaq.ai to stop accepting this site’s access token.

Terms of Service: https://seyaq.ai/en/terms
Privacy Policy: https://seyaq.ai/en/privacy
sections.installation:
1. In WordPress, go to Plugins → Add New, search for “Seyaq for WooCommerce”, then Install Now and Activate.
  2. The Seyaq screen opens. Click Connect to Seyaq, then sign in or create your Seyaq account.
  3. Approve Seyaq in WooCommerce when asked. You come back to the Seyaq screen, connected, and your products start syncing.

Already connected your store in your Seyaq dashboard? Connect recognises it.
sections.faq:
How much does Seyaq cost?

Seyaq has plans for stores of every size, and a free trial is available. See plans and prices.

Is it available in Arabic?

Yes. Every Seyaq screen is in Arabic and right-to-left when your WordPress admin is in Arabic, and your product data is published in Arabic and English.

What data does Seyaq use?

Your products, prices and stock, read through the WooCommerce key you approve.

What happens if I remove the plugin?

Seyaq stops adding anything to your pages. Your Seyaq account, plan and reports stay.

I already have an llms.txt file

A real llms.txt file in your site’s root folder is served by your web server before WordPress runs, so the plugin leaves it alone. Remove the file, or switch the llms.txt option off on the Seyaq screen, to use one or the other.

Does it slow my store down?

No. The loader is a small script that loads asynchronously.
sections.changelog:
2.0.0

  • New: a Seyaq menu with your store’s setup, plan and AI visibility score.
  • New: connect in a few clicks — sign in or create your account from WordPress.
  • New: Dashboard widget, Verify now, and Arabic built in.
  • Updating from 1.0: storefront features keep working; connect once to see your store’s status.

1.0.1

  • Wording: Seyaq’s Store tools page is now part of Connect store, so the settings page and the installation steps point there. No change in how the plugin works.

1.0.0

  • First release: link to your Seyaq store from WordPress, agent page and llms.txt links, Seyaq loader (not on cart, checkout or account pages), /llms.txt redirect. A copy downloaded from Seyaq keeps its link through updates.
